--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CUST_NBR,CUST_STATUS ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_WITH_DUP_20230512  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER
--366
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_WITH_DUP_20230512
--366

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--5 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_WITH_DUP_20230512 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1
